This market will resolve to the tight end who finishes the 2026-27 NFL regular season (Weeks 1 through 18) as the highest-scoring tight end under standard PPR (points-per-reception) scoring per the default scoring of ESPN Fantasy Sports.

If two or more players are tied for the most total PPR fantasy points, this market will resolve in favor of the tied player that has a higher fantasy points per game average for the 2026 NFL regular season. If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the tied player whose last name comes first alphabetically.

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past January 26, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or a leader cannot be determined within this timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source will be official season-total statistics as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports (https://www.espn.com/fantasy/).

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past January 26, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or the rankings cannot be determined within this timeframe, all markets in this event will resolve to "No".

The resolution source will be official season-total statistics as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports (https://www.espn.com/fantasy/).

This market will resolve to "Yes" if the named FLEX-eligible player (running back, wide receiver, or tight end) finishes the 2026-27 NFL regular season (Weeks 1 through 18) ranked among the top 12 FLEX-eligible players by total fantasy points under standard PPR (points-per-reception) scoring per the default scoring of ESPN Fantasy Sports. Otherwise, that market will resolve to "No".

Only regular-season games count; postseason (playoff) games are excluded. If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past January 26, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or the rankings cannot be determined within this timeframe, all markets in this event will resolve to "No".

The resolution source will be official season-total statistics as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports (https://www.espn.com/fantasy/).

Otherwise, that market will resolve to "No".

This market will resolve to "Yes" if the named kicker finishes the 2026-27 NFL regular season (Weeks 1 through 18) ranked among the top 12 kickers by total fantasy points under standard PPR (points-per-reception) scoring per the default scoring of ESPN Fantasy Sports. Otherwise, that market will resolve to "No".

Only regular-season games count; postseason (playoff) games are excluded. If two or more kickers are tied such that more than 12 would qualify for the top 12, the tie will be broken by higher fantasy points per game average for the 2026 NFL regular season, and if a tie still persists, by last name in alphabetical order, so that exactly 12 kickers are classified as top 12.

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past January 26, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or the rankings cannot be determined within this timeframe, all markets in this event will resolve to "No".

The resolution source will be official season-total statistics as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports (https://www.espn.com/fantasy/).

title: Fantasy Football: 2026-27 QB Points Per Game (PPR)

This market will resolve to "Yes" if Dak Prescott's average fantasy points per game during the 2026-27 NFL regular season (Weeks 1 through 18) equals or exceeds 18.0 under standard PPR (points-per-reception) scoring per the default scoring of ESPN Fantasy Sports. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Average fantasy points per game is the player's total PPR fantasy points for the 2026-27 NFL regular season divided by the number of regular season games in which the player appeared, as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports. Only regular season games count; postseason (playoff) games are excluded. There is no minimum number of games played. If the listed player does not appear in any 2026-27 NFL regular season game, this market will resolve to "No".

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past January 26, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or the per-game averages cannot be determined within this timeframe, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source will be official season statistics as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports (https://www.espn.com/fantasy/).

title: Fantasy Football: 2026-27 TE Points Per Game (PPR)
description:

Average fantasy points per game is the player's total PPR fantasy points for the 2026-27 NFL regular season divided by the number of regular season games in which the player appeared, as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports. title: Pro Football: 2026-27 Last Unbeaten Team
description:
This market will resolve according to the team that remains without a single loss the longest during the 2026-27 NFL regular season.

Ties do not count as losses.

If at any point it becomes impossible for the listed team to be the last team remaining without a loss, the corresponding market will resolve to "No".

If multiple teams suffer their first loss on the same day, or if multiple teams finish the 2026-27 NFL regular season without a loss, this market will resolve in favor of the tied team that played the most games before recording its first loss, regardless of the number of ties recorded by those teams.

If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the tied team with the greater strength of victory in all games, and then the tied team with the greater strength of schedule in all games, as those terms are used in the NFL's official tie-breaking procedures (https://www.nfl.com/standings/tie-breaking-procedures). If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the tied team whose full team name, as listed in this market, comes first alphabetically. The "Other" option will not be considered in these tie-breaks.

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed after January 24, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or the team that remained without a loss the longest cannot be determined within that timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the NFL (https://www.nfl.com/); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

title: What will the announcers say during the 49ers vs Seahawks game?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed term is mentioned by a play-by-play announcer or a game analyst of the official FOX announce team during the English-language broadcast of the San Francisco 49ers vs Seattle Seahawks game on FOX, scheduled for October 11, 2026 at 4:25 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

This market will resolve based on the events of the official game broadcast, beginning from the opening kickoff and ending with the conclusion of the final play of the game, including any overtime, if applicable. Pregame coverage, halftime studio coverage, and postgame commentary will not be considered.

For the purpose of this market, the "FOX announce team" refers only to the play-by-play announcer and the game analyst or analysts calling this game from the broadcast booth. Remarks made by sideline reporters, rules or officiating analysts, studio hosts, guest commentators, in-booth guests, players, coaches, or any other individuals will not count toward resolution, including when such remarks air during in-game interviews or in-game segments.

The resolution source for this market is the national FOX telecast of this game. Any alternate or simultaneous presentation of this game, including alternate broadcasts, alternate audio or commentary feeds, and separately produced local team telecasts, will not be considered for resolution purposes. Only remarks made live during the official broadcast will count toward this market's resolution. Transcripts will not count.

For full rules, see: https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/market_products/Mentions/Event+Mentions+Contract+DeFi.pdf

In the second half of the NFL game between Titans and Bengals, scheduled for November 1 at 1:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Bengals" if the Bengals outscore the Titans by 10 or more points in the second half.

Points scored in the second half and in any overtime count toward this market. First-half points are not included.

title: Fantasy Football: 2026-27 Week 6 Overall Points Leader (PPR)

Only games designated by the NFL as Week 6 of the 2026-27 regular season count. If two or more players are tied for the most fantasy points in Week 6, this market will resolve in favor of the tied player whose last name comes first alphabetically.

The resolution source will be official Week 6 statistics as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports (https://www.espn.com/fantasy/).

This market will resolve in favor of the player that finishes Week 6 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season with the most scrimmage yards (rushing yards plus receiving yards).

Only games designated by the NFL as Week 6 of the 2026-27 regular season count.

In the event of a tie, this market will resolve in favor of the tied player with more scrimmage touchdowns (rushing touchdowns plus receiving touchdowns) in Week 6 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season. If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the player with a higher average of scrimmage yards per touch (scrimmage yards divided by the sum of rushing attempts and receptions) in Week 6 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season. If a tie still persists, this market will resolve to "Other".

If Week 6 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season is shortened or truncated for any reason, the outcome shall be determined using available NFL statistics for completed games.

If Week 6 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past November 4, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or it is unclear which player led the NFL in scrimmage yards within that timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the NFL; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
